prompt_md: A cone-shaped glass, point down, holds exactly half as much drink as it can. How high does the drink reach, as a percent of the glass's height?
prompt_short: Cone glass, point down, half full by volume. Drink height as % of glass?
hint_md: A cone of drink is a smaller copy of the glass. Volume scales with height cubed.
explain_intuition_md: Halfway up a cone glass looks half full but holds only an eighth, because the wide top is where the volume is. To hold half, the drink must reach almost four-fifths of the way up.
